Huge bold condensed Swiss grotesk headline on left, three slightly rotated thin navy outlined editorial strips on right, middle strip cobalt with white type. Simple hand drawn outline icons. Exact strip text "Search people" / "Read profiles" / "Prepare better conversations". Bottom exact text "Give your AI professional context before the next meeting." Footer "Research prospects, collaborators and people in your network." Only these texts.
